# ScribeRelay Copilot instructions

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and [documentation governance](../docs/README.md). This repository is currently documentation-first. Do not generate production implementation or select production dependencies until the owner approves requirements and architecture. Isolated feasibility spikes require owner-approved scope and must remain separate from production code.

Use concise Markdown, explicit status and evidence, and relative links. Separate source normalization from destination-specific conversion in proposed designs. Prioritize content fidelity, privacy, transparent compatibility reporting, and user-controlled publishing. Flag uncertainty rather than inventing validation. Do not commit secrets or private source documents.
